narr: A weak low pressure system moved into northeast Indiana, with a slow moving cold front extending southeast through central Illinois. Widespread showers and thunderstorms developed south of I-72 and moved east during the morning. Near I-70, training thunderstorms led to heavy rain and isolated flash flooding.
ev: Road closed due to flooding at Jefferson Avenue and Walnut St.
lsr: ROAD CLOSED AT JEFFERSON AVE AND WALNUT ST DUE TO FLOODING.
